note: Findings raised by verification passes that the offline validator cannot detect on its own. validate.py merges these into data/review-queue.json. Each entry stays here until a human resolves it and deletes the entry.

findings.reason: During the 2026-08-14 enrichment pass the abstract fetched from the arXiv page did not read like the title recorded in the README. This may be a wrong arXiv id in the README entry, a renamed paper, or an artefact of how the abstract page was fetched (the fetcher returns abstract text only, not the title header), so it must be confirmed by opening the arXiv page by hand before anything is changed.
